name: Mike Woods Invitational
where: Castile, NY · host SUNY Geneseo · Letchworth State Park
headline: Mike Woods Invitational
summary: Final: Men: host No. 2 SUNY Geneseo won with 55, ahead of No. 8 RPI (60), No. 5 NYU (68), No. 13 Carnegie Mellon (84) and No. 18 Amherst (98); Geneseo's Emerson Comer won in 24:58.7. Women: No. 2 NYU scored 20 to beat No. 14 Carnegie Mellon (60) and No. 11 Geneseo (61), and NYU's Josephine Dziedzic won in 21:17.7.
